name: Bayesian Posterior Update for Multiple New Data
aliases: Gaussian posterior update for radiance fields
definition: Computes the posterior distribution of a scene point's color $c(	ext{x})$ given a Gaussian prior and multiple new observed data points $	ext{r}_i$, enabling uncertainty-aware view selection.
summary: This method analytically derives the posterior distribution of a scene point's color from a Gaussian prior and multiple observations, distinguishing itself by explicitly modeling affine color transformations rather than relying on differentiable rendering pipelines.
